name: deckray
description: Decky Loader plugin for VLESS proxy connections with Reality protocol support

scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:eslint && pnpm run lint:prettier
scripts.deploy:simple: pnpm run build && rsync -avz --delete --progress --timeout=30 --partial -e 'ssh -o ServerAliveInterval=10 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3' dist/ package.json plugin.json main.py LICENSE backend/src/ backend/static/ ${DECK_HOST:-steamdeck}:~/homebrew/plugins/deckray/
scripts.package:local: pnpm run build && mkdir -p dist-package/deckray && cp -r dist package.json plugin.json main.py LICENSE dist-package/deckray/ && mkdir -p dist-package/deckray/backend && cp -r backend/src dist-package/deckray/backend/ && (test -d backend/static && cp -r backend/static dist-package/deckray/backend/ || true) && (test -d bin && cp -r bin dist-package/deckray/ || true) && cd dist-package && zip -r ../deckray.zip deckray && cd .. && rm -rf dist-package && echo '✅ ZIP created: deckray.zip'

author: sazan
